title: Small spatial embeddings from one-way near-inclusions
exact_target: Does arbitrarily small one-way unit-ball distance from a unital von Neumann algebra M to N, acting on the same Hilbert space, force a unitary u arbitrarily close to 1 with $uMu*\subseteq N$? The claim concerns small implementing unitaries, not the existence of an unrestricted spatial embedding.

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
